subject: Full-loop orchestration: sprint orbit, evaluator stitch, and preflight checklist
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate Samir Kapoor — full loop preflight

Evelyn,

Can you take point on Samir's virtual onsite? He’s confirmed for week of May 26 and needs a compact 4-slot loop across two time windows so we can accommodate PST/EET overlap. Draft agenda attached. High-level asks:

- 4 interviews: Intro (recruiter), System Design, Product/PM fit, Culture & Leadership.
- Prefer 45m design, 30m for others, 15m debrief buffer after each block.
- Prefer Karthik on Design, Laura on Product backup.

Please propose panel order and ownership; also flag any clocking constraints for Karthik. cc'ing Karthik to confirm.

Thanks,

Laura
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2025-05-14_Samir_Kapoor_agenda_draft.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Samir Kapoor — full loop preflight

Thanks Laura — happy to own orchestration.

Proposed sequencing (two-window plan):

Window A (09:00–13:00 PST) — candidate in PST/EET overlap
1) Intro (30m) — Laura
2) System Design (45m) — Karthik
3) Product deep-dive (30m) — Evelyn
4) Culture & leadership (30m) — hiring manager (TBD)

Window B (12:00–16:00 PST) — backup
1) Intro (30m)
2) Product (30m)
3) System Design (45m)
4) Culture (30m)

Notes:
- I propose moving System Design to slot 2 in Window A to surface architecture trade-offs early; this reduces context switching.
- Add 15m async debrief buffer at the end of each window.
- I have a hard stop 15:30 PST on May 26; Karthik, can you confirm if you can do the 10:00–11:00 PST System Design slot? If not, we can swap with Product.

I'll create calendar blocks and share a short preflight checklist for the candidate (device, recordings consent, prompt-set overview). Attached is the agenda v1.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Technical Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2025-05-14_Samir_Kapoor_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 58KB)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-preflight-doc

From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@example.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Full-loop orchestration: scheduling

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the note and proposed windows. Both work for me, prefer Window A (earlier). I'm available May 26 in the morning (09:00–13:00 PST). A couple of quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether the System Design exercise will be whiteboard-style (no laptop) or laptop? I prefer laptop with codesketch ability.
- I attached an updated resume with portfolio links.

Cheers,
Samir

Attachments: Samir_Kapoor_resume.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-15T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Samir Kapoor — full loop preflight

I can do 10:00–10:45 PST for System Design on May 26. Laptop format is fine — I'll bring a short prompt and a 25–30m design session plus 15m Q&A. Suggest swapping Product to slot 3 in Window A to keep design momentum.

-Karthik

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-15T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Samir Kapoor — Virtual onsite (May 26) + preflight

Hi all — confirmed for May 26 (Window A). Calendar invites sent to all interviewers and candidate. Final order:

09:00–09:30 — Intro / kickoff (Laura)
09:40–10:25 — System Design (Karthik) — laptop format
10:40–11:10 — Product deep-dive (Evelyn)
11:20–11:50 — Culture & leadership (Hiring manager)
11:50–12:05 — Debrief buffer (interviewers)

Preflight checklist for Samir (also on Drive):
- Join via Chrome, camera on, stable network
- System Design: laptop shared screen + editor; please have any notes ready
- Consent: session recording for calibration (opt-out allowed)

Attachments: 2025-05-14_Samir_Kapoor_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 65KB)
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123-samir-onsite
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-preflight

Thanks everyone — Laura, can you add the hiring manager once they accept? Karthik, I'll ping you 24h prior with the prompt.

Evelyn
Technical Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference
